name: blazing-video
description: Record your screen, face and voice on your Mac, edit the video by its transcript, and share a link — from Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Blazing Video Mac app. Ask Claude to start and stop a recording, read the transcript, cut filler words, pauses and false starts, trim the start and end, look at frames, export an MP4 and share or update a link that plays instantly. Recording and transcription happen on your Mac; the connector talks only to the Blazing Video app on this Mac (127.0.0.1). Needs Blazing Video installed and running (macOS 15 or later): https://blazingvideo.com/download
